webster.text: Worthy of censure; blamable; culpable; reprehensible; faulty; as a censurable person, or censurable conduct or writings.

example.quote: I submit it to the consideration of the gentlemen, whether, if it be reprehensible in the one case, it can bo censurable in the other.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
